name: ORPHENADRINE CITRATE
indications_original: Orphenadrine citrate extended-release tablets are indicated as an adjunct to rest, physical therapy, and other measures for the relief of discomfort associated with acute painful musculoskeletal conditions.
contraindications_original:
Adults
                  
                  Two tablets per day; one in the morning and one in the evening.
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
Orphenadrine citrate extended-release tablets 100 mg are round, white to off-white tablets, debossed NL4 on one side and plain on the other side and are supplied as:
                  
                  NDC: 70518-4506-00
                  NDC: 70518-4506-01

                  PACKAGING: 14 in 1 BOTTLE PLASTIC
                  OUTER PACKAGING: 50 in 1 BOX

adverseReactions_original: Orphenadrine citrate extended-release tablets are contraindicated in patients with glaucoma, pyloric or duodenal obstruction, stenosing peptic ulcers, prostatic hypertrophy or obstruction of the bladder neck, cardio-spasm (mega-esophagus) and myasthenia gravis. Orphenadrine citrate tablets are contraindicated in patients who have demonstrated a previous hypersensitivity to the drug.
